name: GearBeacon
releaseNotes: GearBeacon 1.4.1 includes all changes since 1.4.0: failed-delivery retry and dismissal controls with one bounded recovery cycle after an outage; atomic Store observations, activity, delivery jobs, watch and rule changes, and collection purchase actions; Store response-body timeouts; validated primary backups, rollback-safe restore, and installation-scoped cleanup of secondary copies and abandoned temporary files; Windows checkout vault DPAPI and ACL protection; reliable Windows service web replacement; and Operations refresh on reconnection. Schema v15 and export format v10 are unchanged. Read the complete release notes for recovery, upgrade, and optional companion guidance.
